title: Berachain (BERA) Explained: Fundamentals and Future Potential
content:
As of April 23, 2026, the broader cryptocurrency market maintains a total capitalization of $2.68T, with [Bitcoin](/bitcoin) dominance hovering at 58.1%. Against this backdrop of consolidation, Berachain (BERA) has emerged as a focal point for developers and liquidity providers looking for alternative execution environments. Berachain is a high-performance Layer 1 blockchain built on the Cosmos SDK, utilizing the Proof-of-Liquidity (PoL) consensus mechanism. It aims to solve the fragmentation of liquidity that plagues many modular blockchain ecosystems by integrating liquidity directly into its core consensus.
